title: List of Some Questionable E-Numbers to Be Aware of

blocks.text: Q1. These ingredients are made from plant oils, animal fats or synthetically. Many are combinations of various fatty acids (i.e., stearates, oleates, laureates) with glycerol (glycerine) and other chemicals, hence they are questionable or doubtful in nature. Look for Halal certified products where the doubt has been cleared or inquire from the manufacturer about the source of such ingredients.

Q2. These ingredients are made from plant proteins, animal proteins, synthetic sources or through biotechnology. The basic ingredients here are the amino acids, which may be derived from complete break down of the proteins or made chemically. Look for Halal certified products where the doubt has been cleared.
